title: Reseller marks of a work account
summary: Trabalho → Selos de revenda, on a company account (ADR 0162, bipe-chat/bipe#486). A reseller enters a brand's code or link, sees what the brand will and will not see, and accepts or refuses the mark; the reseller removes a mark at any time. A brand with a verified seal makes single-use codes for one mark, sees which accounts hold its mark and ends a mark.

line.description: The mark's line with the brand's name.

reseller.description: The reseller's display name from the Matrix profile, else the Matrix ID.

line.description: The mark's line with the brand's own name.

code.description: The field bipe_brand_marks_code_field. The app takes the 16-character code out of a pasted link or message.

offer.description: GET /v1/brand-marks/invites/{code}: a sheet with the line, the brand's CNPJ, bipe_brand_marks_brand_sees and bipe_brand_marks_brand_not_sees, then accept and refuse.

brandName.description: GET /v1/me/business: the trade name, else the legal name, of a verified claim with an active registry record. Absent: the grant section shows bipe_brand_marks_not_verified only.

createdCode.description: CreatedBrandMarkInvite.code and link, shown once with copy and share, and bipe_brand_marks_code_ready with the invite's days.

of.description: An open invite: its line and expiry, with bipe_brand_marks_cancel_code.

error.description: codeInvalid: 404 (never says why). limit: 409 brand_mark_limit. alreadyHeld, ownBrand: 400 bad_request with that reason. notVerified: 403 brand_not_verified. failed: anything else, bipe_brand_marks_failed.

check.effect: Previews the code in the field.

accept.effect: POST /v1/brand-marks/invites/{code}/accept, then reloads held. The mark shows to customers at their next check.

refuse.effect: POST /v1/brand-marks/invites/{code}/refuse. The code is used; no mark.

makeCode.effect: POST /v1/me/brand-marks/invites with the label picked under bipe_brand_mark_title; shows createdCode.

notes: No mark without the reseller's yes (ADR 0162 point 2): accept is a separate tap after the offer, and the offer says what the brand sees and does not see.
The brand side is in the same screen because the brand also uses a company account. The grant section needs the account's verified claim; the API still checks it (403 brand_not_verified).
A mark ended by either side goes from customers' phones within brandMarkRecheckMinutes (spec brand-mark).
The code never goes into a log. The link is PUBLIC_SITE_URL/marca/#<code>; the app does not open it as a deep link yet, so the reseller pastes it.
